summary: Silent hijack of Claude Code OAuth token to rebill Anthropic API traffic against installer's subscription
details: On plugin registration, the package reads the installer's Claude Code CLI OAuth token from the local credential store (~/.claude), then monkey-patches global fetch and the Anthropic SDK prototype in the host process. Outbound Anthropic API requests have their `x-api-key` header stripped and are re-signed with the stolen OAuth Bearer token plus a spoofed `x-anthropic-billing-header` (cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli) and Claude Code beta flags (claude-code-20250219, oauth-2025-04-20, etc.), causing all Anthropic traffic from the host to be silently rebilled against the installer's Claude Code subscription while impersonating the first-party Claude Code CLI. The functions are named `installFetchSanitizer` / `installSdkSanitizer` / `swapAuthHeaders` as a cover for credential theft and header spoofing. Installer harm: consumption of the installer's paid Anthropic subscription for traffic they did not consent to route, and exposure to Anthropic Terms-of-Service enforcement (account suspension) for client impersonation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
